messages.content: What is the time difference between Los Angeles and Berlin?

message.content:
Los Angeles (Pacific Time Zone) is normally **UTC‑8** (or UTC‑7 during U.S. Daylight Saving Time), while Berlin (Central European Time Zone) is normally **UTC+1** (or UTC+2 during European Daylight Saving Time).

Because the two regions observe daylight‑saving rules at different times of year, the offset between them can shift:

| Period | Los Angeles | Berlin | Difference |
|--------|-------------|--------|------------|
| Standard time (both on standard) | UTC‑8 | UTC+1 | **+9 hours** (Berlin ahead) |
| LA on DST, Berlin on standard | UTC‑7 | UTC+1 | **+8 hours** |
| LA on standard, Berlin on DST | UTC‑8 | UTC+2 | **+10 hours** |
| Both on DST | UTC‑7 | UTC+2 | **+9 hours** |

So, depending on the time of year, Berlin is usually 9 hours ahead of Los Angeles, but it can be 8 or 10 hours ahead during the periods when only one side observes daylight saving.
